title: How is HRA exemption calculated?
question: How much HRA exemption can a salaried employee claim for FY 2026-27?
shortAnswer: HRA exemption is the least of: actual HRA received, rent paid minus 10% of basic salary, or 50%/40% of basic salary (metro/non-metro).
fullAnswer: Under Section 10(13A), a salaried employee receiving HRA can claim exemption equal to the minimum of three values: (1) actual HRA received from employer, (2) rent paid minus 10% of basic salary + DA, (3) 50% of basic + DA if living in a metro city (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai), otherwise 40%. Only available under the old tax regime.
